Download a File

Source: R/lib_data_loader.R
dldata.Rd

Downloads one file to a path on disk through the package's own transport, bldl(), and returns the path. It is the plain download step of a data pipeline: resolve a URL (for example with rslvckan()), download it with this function, then check it with vrfsha256(). Use fdl() instead when a person should see advice about the failure and a Wayback Machine fallback.

Usage

dldata(url, tpath, mode = "wb", quiet = FALSE, allowfile = FALSE)

Arguments

url

The URL to download, a single string.

tpath

Destination path on disk, a single string. Its directory must exist.

mode

Kept for the signature of utils::download.file(); only "wb" (the default) or "w" is accepted. Every transfer is binary and written fresh through the package's own transport, so an append mode cannot be honoured and is an error rather than a silent "wb".

quiet

Logical. TRUE suppresses the progress output; FALSE (the default) shows it.

allowfile

Logical. Accept a file:// URL (default FALSE; offline tests and examples pass TRUE). Every URL must otherwise be https and public.

Value

The tpath, returned invisibly.

Details

Before anything is fetched the URL must be one public https URL: plain http needs the option rmoriebricklayer.allowhttp set to TRUE, file:// needs allowfile = TRUE, and loopback, private, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused. The transport then resolves the host, pins the connection to the checked addresses, re-checks every redirect hop, caps the body at 2 GiB and allows 3600 seconds for the transfer. The file at tpath is overwritten. Errors from the transfer (network, HTTP status, size cap) propagate as R errors; nothing partial is left behind.

Progress is drawn on stderr while quiet = FALSE, whatever the morie.quiet option says, because the value is passed to the transport explicitly.

Errors: url or tpath not a single non-empty string; a refused URL; mode other than "wb" or "w".

Examples

# offline: a local file through a file:// URL
src <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
writeLines(c("id,value", "1,10", "2,20"), src)
dest <- dldata(paste0("file://", src), tempfile(fileext = ".csv"),
  quiet = TRUE, allowfile = TRUE)
read.csv(dest)
#>   id value
#> 1  1    10
#> 2  2    20

# file:// is refused unless asked for, and so is an append mode
try(dldata(paste0("file://", src), tempfile()))
#> Error : url must be an https:// URL, not file:// ('file:///tmp/Rtmpgq1Nbw/file1f025e0980da.csv'); options(rmoriebricklayer.allowhttp = TRUE) admits a trusted plain-http mirror
try(dldata("https://example.org/x.csv", tempfile(), mode = "a"))
#> Error : `mode` must be "wb" (every transfer is binary)

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# needs the network
dest <- dldata("https://cloud.r-project.org/",
  tempfile(fileext = ".html"),
  quiet = TRUE
)
file.exists(dest)
}
